'''Woern's Assault Shuttle''' was a modified [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] that was used by [[Laerron Woern]] as his command ship. He received it after the ship was found abandoned after a battle. He removed all of the launch ports for the [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s except for two and converted the excess space into storage and benches.<ref name="WBC" />
